radius_note: 95% radius, Monte Carlo 60 trials: control-point coordinates perturbed by ±10 m (--pt-sigma), pixels by ±1.3 px. Median offset 40.3 m. The old pixel-noise-only measure is in radius_px_only_m; it doesn't cover the ground truth.

leave_one_out.note: with 4 points, dropping one leaves no more equations than unknowns, so the per-point check can't be done; add another point, or fix height/roll
